sbh4.3:1.1: Printed *apṛthagjanasandhāraṇānām*, so the MS; read *apṛthagjanāsādhāraṇānām* with Tibetan and Xuanzang (Deleanu 2006, n. 462).
sbh4.3:1.3: Printed text and the MS omit *apramāṇābhānām*; supplied with Tibetan and Xuanzang (Deleanu 2006, n. 466).
sbh4.3:1.4: Printed *sapramāṇaśubhānāṁ, śubhakṛtyānāṁ*; read *apramāṇaśubhānāṁ, śubhakṛtsnānāṁ* (MS per Deleanu 2006, nn. 467–468).
sbh4.3:1.8: Printed *adahe(hre)ṣv*, and the printed text omits *sudṛśeṣu*; read *avṛheṣv* and supply *sudṛśeṣu* (MS per Deleanu 2006, nn. 473–476).
sbh4.3:1.17: Printed *na tāsu(su) īryāntaraṁ*, the MS unclear; read *na cāśu īryā[patha]ntaraṁ* with Tibetan (Deleanu 2006, nn. 480–481).
sbh4.3:3.3: Printed *śramaṇenodgṛhītayogācāraḥ*, so the MS; read *śravaṇenodgṛhītavān yogācāraḥ* with Tibetan and Xuanzang (ŚBh-Gr IV(1), 2024, p. (94) n. 3).
sbh4.3:3.5: Printed text omits *śūnyākāreṇa*; supplied from the MS (per ŚBh-Gr IV(1), 2024, p. (94) n. 4).
sbh4.3:4.3: Printed *avināśākāreṇa*, so the MS; read *vināśākāreṇa* with Tibetan and Xuanzang (ŚBh-Gr IV(1), 2024, p. (96) n. 2).
sbh4.3:4.5: Printed *anupa(kāreṇa)lambhākāreṇa*, the MS *anupākāreṇa lambhākāreṇa*, corrupt; read *anupalambhākāreṇa* with Tibetan and Xuanzang (ŚBh-Gr IV(1), 2024, p. (96) n. 5). Printed *asvātantrākāreṇa*; read *asvātantryākāreṇa* (MS per the same note).
sbh4.3:5.2: Printed text repeats *ity anena tāvat paryāyeṇa* (ŚBh-Gr IV(1), 2024, p. (98) n. 4).
sbh4.3:5.7: Printed *bhājanalaukika(loka)sthānityatā*, the MS *bhājanalaukikasyānityatā*; read *bhājanalokasyānityatā* (ŚBh-Gr IV(1), 2024, p. (100) n. 3).
sbh4.3:6.1: Printed *api parokṣatām*, so the MS here; read *aviparokṣatām*, as the MS's repeat of the sentence (6.7) reads, with Tibetan and Xuanzang (ŚBh-Gr IV(1), 2024, p. (100) n. 5, p. (102) n. 4).
sbh4.3:6.7: Printed text repeats 6.1–6.2 after *bāhyaṁ vastu* (MS dittography, running to the opening of 6.11; deleted in ŚBh-Gr IV(1), 2024, p. (102) n. 4).
sbh4.3:6.11: Printed text repeats the opening of 6.7.
sbh4.3:6.15: Printed text and the MS lack *abvastu tadyathā*; supplied with Tibetan and Xuanzang (ŚBh-Gr IV(1), 2024, p. (102) n. 8).
sbh4.3:6.16: Printed text omits *bhojanapānayāna-*; supplied from the MS (per ŚBh-Gr IV(1), 2024, p. (104) n. 3).
sbh4.3:6.24: Printed *svayaṁkṛtaḥ* and *kṛṣikṛtaḥ*; read *sparśakṛtaḥ* and *vyādhikṛtaḥ* (MS margin, per ŚBh-Gr IV(1), 2024, p. (108) nn. 1–2).
sbh4.3:8.7: Printed text repeats the end of 8.6 and the opening of 8.8 (MS dittography, which Shukla notes may be deleted; deleted in ŚBh-Gr IV(1), 2024, p. (112) n. 7).
sbh4.3:9.2: Printed *vastūny*, so the MS; read *vastrāṇy* with Tibetan and Xuanzang (ŚBh-Gr IV(1), 2024, p. (114) n. 3).
sbh4.3:9.3: Printed *sukhavedanīyaḥ*, so the MS; read *duḥkhavedanīyaḥ* with Tibetan and Xuanzang (ŚBh-Gr IV(1), 2024, p. (114) n. 6).
sbh4.3:9.4: Printed *su(duḥ)khavedanīya(ḥ)*; read *sukhavedanīyaḥ* (MS per ŚBh-Gr IV(1), 2024, p. (114) n. 8). Printed *-sy[ā ']sukhavedanīyasya vā[']duḥkhavedanīyasya vā*, with Shukla's privatives; read *vedayamānasya sukhavedanīyasya vā duḥkhavedanīyasya vā* (MS per p. (116) n. 1).
sbh4.3:9.11: Printed text omits *jñānāny*; supplied from the MS, read *vijñānāny* (ŚBh-Gr IV(1), 2024, p. (116) n. 5).
sbh4.3:9.18: Printed *tathāpy eṣāṁ*, so the MS; read *tathā hy eṣāṁ* with Xuanzang (ŚBh-Gr IV(2), 2025, p. (64) n. 6).
sbh4.3:9.20: Printed *ihānenātmano (sa tathātmano) vā, pareṣām vā, yā pūrvaṁ(tām a)sva(su)varṇatā(tāṁ), succhavitā(tāṁ) tvagvarṇatā(tām)*, with Shukla's conjectures; read *ihānenātmano vā pareṣāṁ vā yā pūrvaṁ suvarṇatā succhavitā paryavadātatvagvarṇatā* (MS per ŚBh-Gr IV(2), 2025, p. (66) n. 2).
sbh4.3:9.23: Printed text omits *succhavitāṁ*; supplied from the MS (per ŚBh-Gr IV(2), 2025, p. (66) n. 3).
sbh4.3:9.26: Printed text and the MS lack the question; supplied after Tibetan and Xuanzang (ŚBh-Gr IV(2), 2025, p. (70) n. 1).
sbh4.3:9.29: Printed text repeats 9.33 (MS miscopy of 9.33, 9.20 and 9.27–9.28 at this point; deleted in ŚBh-Gr IV(2), 2025, p. (70) n. 2).
sbh4.3:9.34: Printed *pūrvam api(vi)kalāṅgatā*, the MS *api kalāṅgatā*; read *avikalāṅgatā* with Tibetan and Xuanzang (ŚBh-Gr IV(2), 2025, p. (72) n. 3).
sbh4.3:10.1: Printed *vākkarma*, so the MS; read *vā karma* with Tibetan and Xuanzang (ŚBh-Gr IV(2), 2025, p. (74) n. 3).
sbh4.3:12.2: Printed text repeats *aviśadakāyaṁ saṁkucitakāyaṁ śītaparyavasthānaparyavasthita-* from 12.1 (MS dittography; deleted in ŚBh-Gr IV(2), 2025, p. (78) n. 3). Printed *ucchraṣya vacanaṁ*, the MS *ucchuṣya vacanaṁ*; read *ucchuṣkavadanam* with Tibetan (n. 4).
sbh4.3:12.6: Printed *śītakṛtāṁ*, so the MS; read *śītoṣṇakṛtāṁ* with Tibetan and the list at 6.23 (ŚBh-Gr IV(2), 2025, p. (78) n. 6).
sbh4.3:12.7: Printed text and the MS lack the participle; read *upahanyamānaṁ* after Tibetan and Xuanzang (ŚBh-Gr IV(2), 2025, p. (80) n. 4).
sbh4.3:13.5: Printed *pūrvāṁ paryeṣaṇā*, the MS *pūrvā paryeṣaṇā*; read *paurvāparyeṇa* with Tibetan and Xuanzang (ŚBh-Gr IV(2), 2025, p. (84) n. 1). Printed *āpāyikatāṁ*, so the MS; read *āyāpāyikatāṁ* with Tibetan (n. 4).
sbh4.3:14.6: Printed *avatīparṇa-*; read *avadīrṇa-* (MS per ŚBh-Gr IV(2), 2025, p. (86) n. 4).
sbh4.3:15.4: Printed text repeats the heading of 14.1, with 15.5–15.6 repeating 15.2–15.3 (MS dittography; deleted in ŚBh-Gr IV(2), 2025, p. (88) n. 5).
sbh4.3:17.2: Printed text anticipates 18.2 here (MS; deleted in ŚBh-Gr IV(2), 2025, p. (92) n. 2; Tibetan and Xuanzang lack it).
sbh4.3:18.1: Printed *asaṁkhyā(ya)na-*, the MS *asaṁkhyāyana-*; read *sarveṇa sarvam asaṁprakhyāna-* with 6.24, Tibetan and Xuanzang (ŚBh-Gr IV(2), 2025, p. (94) n. 1).
sbh4.3:18.9: Printed *paśyaty anabhisaṁskṛtān paśyaty anandinavān*; read *paśyaty abhinavān*, *anabhisaṁskṛtān paśyaty* a repetition (Xuanzang 後見新造).
sbh4.3:19.16: Printed *kvāthyamānām asām ante*; read *kvāthyamānānām apām ante* (Xuanzang 煎水).
sbh4.3:20.2: Printed *avarṇā* and *ādyakulīnā*; read *suvarṇā* and *āḍhyakulīnā* (Xuanzang 好形色, 富族姓).
sbh4.3:22.8: Printed *anābhoge (gate) 'dhvani*; read *anāgate 'dhvani*, as later in the segment (Xuanzang 未來世).
sbh4.3:22.9: Printed *saṁbhuravībhūtām*; read *saṁmukhībhūtām* (Xuanzang 現前). Printed *sannihitākārāya(rayā?)*, corrupt; the aspect's name follows 23.2.
sbh4.3:22.18: Printed *abījānugatā*; read *bījānugatā* (Xuanzang 苦樂種子之所隨逐).
sbh4.3:22.25: Printed *yogakṣemākāram*; read *ayogakṣemākāram* with 22.23 (Xuanzang 不安隱行).
sbh4.3:22.28: Printed *hatā ātmeti hatātmeti*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang (我我所).
sbh4.3:22.33: Printed *hīyeta* and *kṛtakṛtānāṁ*; read *jīryeta* and *kṛtānāṁ* (Xuanzang 老者, 能造諸業).
sbh4.3:23.2: Printed text omits *vināśākāreṇa*; supplied from 21.12 (Xuanzang 滅壞行).
sbh4.3:23.8: Printed *duḥkhakṣemakatvāt*; read *duḥkhākṣepakatvāt*, with the following *ākṣipya* (Xuanzang 能引苦).
sbh4.3:23.27: Printed *aśeṣoparamecchātaḥ* and *tadantaratvāt*; read *aśeṣoparamāc chāntataḥ* and *tadanuttaratvāt* (Xuanzang 寂靜, 無上).
sbh4.3:23.33: Printed text repeats 23.32, carrying its *manaskāraḥ* (Xuanzang has the sentence once).
sbh4.3:24.1: Printed text gives 24.1–24.4 and again 24.5–24.6 (dittography; Xuanzang has the passage once); rendered once, the head here and the rest at 24.5.
sbh4.3:24.4: Printed text repeats the opening of 24.6 and the end of 23.32.
sbh4.3:25.3: Printed text repeats *-āsanniśrayākāreṇa* after *prātikūlyādhikāreṇa* (Xuanzang has three aspects).
sbh4.3:25.9: Printed text repeats *rūpaśabda… upacitaṁ* within the segment (Shukla marks it a repetition).
sbh4.3:25.14: Printed *na pratyudāvarttate*; read *pratyudāvartate* (Xuanzang 其心退轉; 26.13 negates it).
sbh4.3:25.31: Printed *sa tasyāvakāśaḥ*; read with a negative (Xuanzang 無容得生 'has no room to arise').
sbh4.3:26.8: Printed *na tāny*; read *tāny* (Xuanzang 能正悟入).
sbh4.3:27.1: Printed *cittaparikṣayābhisaṁskāraḥ*; read *cittaparīkṣā-* (Xuanzang 後後觀心所有加行).
sbh4.3:27.5: Printed *tad ālambanaṁ*; read *tad anālambanaṁ* (Xuanzang 非無緣).
sbh4.3:28.26: Printed *saṁcidhyaṇikṣāṁ*, corrupt; read *saṁcintya śikṣāṁ* (Xuanzang 故思違越所學).
sbh4.3:28.33: Printed *sukhāvalokako* and (28.34) *sukhaparīkṣakaḥ*; read *mukha-* (Xuanzang 不觀瞻口及顏面; SN 56.39:3.2 *mukhaṁ ullokenti*).
sbh4.3:28.43: Printed *baddhaṁ*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 暫起微劣諸煩惱纏 'a weak obsession arises for a moment'.
sbh4.3:28.46: Printed *mārgābhyām aprabhāvitaḥ*; read *mārgābhyāsaprabhāvitaḥ* (Xuanzang 如所得道而正修習).
sbh4.3:28.57: Printed text repeats *ekatyān dharmān prajahāti* (Shukla marks it a repetition).
sbh4.3:28.62: Printed *balenādhivāsayati*; read *balena nādhivāsayati* (Xuanzang 令不忍受).
sbh4.3:29.28: Printed *kleśondhakṣayāya jñānam*, corrupt; read *kleśakṣaye kṣayajñānam*, paired with 29.29 (Xuanzang 盡智).
sbh4.3:29.44: Printed text is lacunose from here to 29.65 (Shukla: MS photo blurred, leaf damaged); the conjectural phrases follow Xuanzang (T1579 juan 34), who has the passage in full; cf. AN 10.20:2.3.
sbh4.3:29.47: Printed *caivaṁ sumanāḥ* and (29.48) *suṣṭhumanāḥ*; read *naiva sumanā … na durmanāḥ* (Xuanzang 無喜無憂; AN 10.20:4.2).
sbh4.3:29.53: Printed *mārgakāśeṣadhātupratiṣṭhite*, corrupt; read *sopadhiśeṣanirvāṇadhātau pratiṣṭhito* (Xuanzang 住有餘依般涅槃界; cf. 29.54).
sbh4.3:29.55: Printed *bhava iṁ gataṁ*, corrupt; read *astaṁ gataṁ* (Xuanzang 滅沒).
sbh4.3:29.57: Printed *sarvopadhipratiniḥsarvasaṁjñākṣayo*; read *sarvopadhipratiniḥsargas tṛṣṇākṣayo* (Xuanzang 棄捨一切所依，愛盡).
sbh4.3:29.63: Printed *ugraduḥkhaṁ praṇītam amavyāya kṛtastubhiḥ*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 不能怖畏一切不應記事 'incapable of fear at the undeclared points'.
sbh4.3:29.65: Printed *sā/mo dha ka* (Shukla: syllables illegible); read with Xuanzang 如是一切名聲聞地 'all this is called the Śrāvakabhūmi'.
sbh4.3:29.67: Printed *kāvyamanuśāstrāṇi*; read *kāvyamantraśāstrāṇām* (Xuanzang 文章、呪術、異論); *mātṛkā* is the predicate, as Xuanzang 根本…猶如…根本.
